* BRep & Tessellation
Mixed mode. In this mode, the B-rep and faceted elements are read from the native file. Tessellation is then generated from B-rep elements.
* Tessellation only
In this mode, all faceted elements from the native file are read. If present, the native tessellation of the B-rep is read exclusively. Native tessellation is the display list integrated in the CAD file (only available for CATIA V5, Solidworks, 3DXML, and Inventor).|__#__
